book.name: METIU
book.title: Yeisu Wasane Dodohobine Metiu wana Luluweli

content: Sahe I Pabikide?
Farisi ge Logugui hana topapalapu topadine si hudi Jerusalem si lok Yeisu heine ge si tayak si nga,
“Mwatan ge lam topadavae si sepalongani logugui gane i hudi he-tutubude heidiye? Taine si desawi nimadiye sohode logugui yake hana hiyede, muyai habeto si hanhan.”
Yeisu i golase halingadiye i nga, “Mwatan ge humiu hu sepalongani Helak wana logugui ge hu gorugoru totomiu he lemi papalapu hei, gane i hudi he-tutubumiu heidiye?
Kaiwane Helak i nga, ‘U hawatau-yanid tamam ge tinam’ ge i nga, ‘Sega hebe i gopangakid tamane ge tinane gen si lopamate.’

Agegene humiu hu liwo sohode ti ya: Hebe bigibigi papaine i gan tolomo hotiya heine tage tamane ge tinane hedi labe kaiwane, hu nga i dohob ege hebe taine i degiyau heidiye ge taine i dehawatau-yanid tamane ge tinane. Humiu hu nga bosowaine ege i liwo heidiye i nga, ‘Bigibigi gane tage a egiyau heimiu hobak a siloyan Helak heine, iye te kaiwane taine a degiyau.’ Hu liwo sohode ti yo, age hu sepalongani Helak wana logugui ge hu gorugoru totomiu he lemi papalapu hei gane i hudi he-tutubumiu heidiye.
Toyoyokapis humiu! Profet Aiseya i govetahe ege, veto i luluweli-yan kaiwamiu sohode ti ya: Helak i nga,

content.text: ‘Bobode ya si hawatau-yanau he hawadiye dimwene,
age hatiyediye hana bwage i mwalao heyau.
Wedi tapwalolo heyau sohode ege bigi bwage,
si papalapu-yan bobode wedi nuwotu tage nau lo logugui.’ ”

content: Yeisu i gon paseid boda si lok heine, habeto nime sawisawi lihuine i gopawayae heidiye i nga, “Gen hu padavae iloke nuwamiu i sapu!
Gane i setuk he hawade taine i depabikide, agegene gane i setagim he hawade iye te i pabikide.”
Habe wana topadavae si luwom heine ge si nga, “Tab u lapu lam lihulihu ya i leme Farisi hatiyediye?”
Yeisu i golase halingadiye i nga, “Bwele si puik yok bigi hohoyowate gane Tamau he bulubulu taine i devahi.
Hu hoteiid! Sidiye todedei-yan matadiye ginginine. Hebe tomatagin i dedeiyan wana pan tomatagin, bwele si toiwo si sopiyele he goi.”
Pita i nga, “Gohalibe ga-ne gen u pawayae heyai.”
Habeto Yeisu i liwo heidiye i nga, “Age habe taine nuwamiu i desapu?
Age taine hu delapu gane i setuk he hawade i dok he tiniyede habeto i setagi he tuwade?
Agegene gane i setagim he hawade, i hudi he hatiyede, iyete iye i pabikide.
Kaiwane nuwotu ngakngakine i setagim he hatiyede: sohode taurol, ganawal, dudubwale, bwahiyewo, pwapwatim yoyokapisi ge loblobae.
Sidiye te i pabikide; age hebe taine ta desawi nimade ge ta hanhan taine i depabikide.”
Keinan Vainiine wana Goru
Yeisu i seyok hiyebe yake, ge i lok i la Taya ge Saidon he wedi ganahao.

Keinan vainiine hotiya i miyemiye te he ganahao yake, iye taine Isrel vainiine sohode. I luwom Yeisu heine ge i gongon i nga, “Guyau, Deivid Tubune, u nuwalolu-yanau! Kaiwane yayaluwo bikbikine i solavi natu vainiine heine ge i papatilao-yan suwok.”
Yeisu taine i degolase halingane, taine lihu hotiya i delihuyan. Habe wana topadavae si luwom heine ge si gogaigaisi heine si nga, “Vaini tei u patile yok, kaiwane i sesegongon he muide.”
Bwen Yeisu i liwo i nga, “Tamau i patileyau a luwom boda Isrel wedi sip haohaoidiye ege kaiwadiye.”
Bwen vaini yake i luwom ge i lipwakoko heine ge i nga, “Guyau, u labeyau.”
Yeisu i golase halingane i nga, “Anamate taine i desapu hebe a labeiwo. Taine bosowaine ta dehowo bubuyese nahadiye ge ta debili yok hehewo heidiye.”
Bwen vaini yake i nga, “Bam, Guyau. Agegene hehewo si han haga mumine, gane i sopiyele tutuidiye he wana teibol i dobu he bwarad, iyete bosowaine ege u labeyau.”
Habeto Yeisu i nga, “Vaini, lam goru i kai. Bwele i youmate sohode lam nuwotu.” Ge he sauge yake natune i molu.
Yeisu I Pamoluid Tobolebole Hoyowate
Yeisu i seyok hiyebe yake ge i la i dodogan he Soge Galili hadidine. Habeto i la i sesai he bobokun ge i tuwodau.

Habe boda non lak si luwom heine ge si yomo luwom tobolebole hoyowate, hebwaden tosesetuhetuhe, tomatagin, hebwaden hehediye i kom, hebwaden tan halingadiye ge topadine hedi, bwen si yomoteiid Yeisu he hehene ge i pamoluid.

Bobode nuwadiye si hape, kaiwane si paidi hebwaden tan halingadiye si lihu, hebwaden hehediye i kom si pasapu, tosesetuhetuhe si dodogan vetahe ge tomatagin matadiye si palale. Iyete heine si tobalan Isrel wedi Helak.
Pe-iwoine Yeisu I Pahanid Boda

Yeisu i gon paseid wana topadavae si luwom heine, habe i nga, “Bobode ya nuwau i ngakanid, kaiwane yan ho-tuwon he-bwaide ta miye, ge hobak taine nahadiye i degan. Taine nuwau sohode bubuwotaidiye ge a patile pahavileid, kaiwane hebe tuwadiye i yaroyaro he hiyede.”
Wana topadavae si liwo heine si nga, “Hiyebe ya i mipabwagebwage, bwele ta howo haga i gohoi ge boda ya ta pahanid?”
Habeto Yeisu i tayakid i nga, “Bred pwahi-piye heimiu?” Si nga, “Pwahi-pik (7) ge yalogi tankaikai bunum-iwo ege.”
I liwo boda si tuwodau he kelekele,
habeto i yomo bred pwahi-pik bwaine yalogi, ge i gomulolu Helak heine, i pieneene-yan, bwen i giyau wana topadavae heidiye ge si talaotan bobode heidiye.
Bwabwaligadiye si han tine sus, habe wedi han tuwoi topadavae si bagavetahe, hana yogowo nabwa-pik.
Bobode henebwaden si hanhan hedi hohoyowate po tausan, agegene taine si dehowo venakau ge gamagai hedi hohoyowate.
Yeisu i patileid boda si yogo, bwen i sai he wage i la Magadan he hana ganahao.

footnotes.text: Bubuyese iye te Isrel bobodeidiye lihuidiye, ge hehewo iye te hebwaden taine Isrel bobodeidiye sohode lihuidiye.
